dimensions.mission: Remove the proven holder feature bottleneck for one preregistered intraday consumer, without executing its real look.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Holder point only; old PRICE/LIQ canonical specs, hashes and results exact. Existing V1-V5 readers, capability identity and trial history owners unchanged.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One field/operator rule and recipe-derived machine labels; existing typed loader, cell clocks, schema, result and packet owners reused. No new tool or dependency.
dimensions.research_truth: Missing, late, conflicting and bad-lineage holder cells fail closed. Threshold/point/target card tampering refused. Prior D2 exposure and activity/staleness confound retained; C1-C4 exploratory. Card explicitly PREDICTIVE with activity/staleness/exposure, frozen taxonomy and additive baseline-minus-matched complement only after subset proof; no causal or known-holder resample claim.
dimensions.owner_operability: Public early preview, saved V5 result, Prompt A, selected card, Critic and owner expose the same exact X/Y. Operator uses generated labels; frozen consumer taxonomy durable. Task L2 explicitly projects the already-declared completion/review/fit receipts; this is evidence visibility, not scientific or merge authority.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: PRICE_RELATIVE_PROXY and assumption-only stress, no NetReturn or entry-edge claim; future surviving gross signal still needs economics and execution gates.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Synthetic public reply loss recovers one landed MAIN; cold replay avoids value loader and new look. Registered capability returns same complete result without writes.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Extend the existing evaluator and packet binding; no holder raw loader, provider call, new capability, parser or budget machinery.
dimensions.security: Disposable synthetic writes only; real C1-C4 holder-Y900 and metadata read-only inventory unchanged. C5 untouched, no credentials/provider/VPS.
dimensions.red_team: Broad-allowlist mutation cannot authorize holder ratios or target. Future point rejects before rows; duplicate conflicts, zero/missing and snapshot lineage use shared owners. Old identities pinned. Corrected nonmonotonic mixed-clock regression is red against prior builder; null/empty public preview clock forms follow canonical normalization.

capability_radar.watch: EARLY_HOLDER_STATE_TO_PRICE_PATH_15M_TO_4H only after merge and separate exact one-MAIN authorization

recovery: Separately authorized ordinary Git revert before real holder look; after saved holder evidence exists preserve its reader and append-only history through forward repair.
